text:
mira: Heads up — planning a short-lived APAC burst lane for g5g-small pools with our partner. Need to lock a strategy for SIN/TKO capacity over the next 6 weeks. Reserved vs spot mix?

sam: Do we have any historical usage patterns for APAC burst? last quarter looked spiky but short TTL.

lee: Quick check — cloud quota in asia-southeast1 currently: 120 GPUs used, 200 quota. We can cover short bursts but not sustained 2k token/s pipelines.

ida: For procurement: vendor said next shipment for G5g boards is 4–5 weeks but can prioritise a small rack if we sign the SOW (lead time +2 weeks). cc @vendor-ops.

vendor-ops: We can do a 16-card burst rack for SIN with 3-week lead time on a prioritised SOW. Need PO by EOW to lock.

mira: Thanks — can we pattern match to expected traffic? If we reserve a small rack, we want autoscaling + spot fallback to avoid overpaying. Thoughts on mixing 1 reserved rack + spot overlay?

sam: That seems sensible. Reserved rack for steady baseline (inference warms), spot overlay for occasional large jobs. Also enable prefix KV cache warmers to reduce cold-start token cost.

eng-bot: FYI deploy pipeline will pin model shards to the reserved pool when "reserve: true" set in infra config. Remember to update rollout policy.

lee: I'll run a quick quota and region availability sweep. Command I'm using:
```bash
gcloud compute reservations list --filter="region:(asia-southeast1 asia-northeast1)" --format="table(name,zone,commitment)"
```
I'll post results shortly.

ida: Procurement note — finance needs estimated monthly committed spend for the PO. Sam, can you sketch cost delta for reserved rack vs spot-only for a 6-week window?

sam: On it. Rough back-of-envelope: reserved ~ $18k/mo for 16-card rack, spot blend could be ~40% cheaper but 15–25% eviction risk. I'll post a short spreadsheet.

mira: If vendor can commit 3-week lead time with PO by Fri, we can cover peak for product launch. If not, fallback plan is skewing traffic to US-west and throttling noncritical batch jobs.

ops-runner: Suggest adding capacity routing rule: prefer apac-reserved, fallback to us-west with degraded SLO and circuit-breaker alert. I can draft the routing rule.

vendor-ops: Confirmed — we will hold the rack option pending PO. Also can provide short-term loaner capacity for 7 days to bridge lead time if needed (nominal fee).

mira: OK — action items: Lee run availability sweep (ETA 10m), Sam send cost spreadsheet (ETA 2h), Ida prep PO checklist for finance. I'll decide on reserve vs loaner after numbers.

lee: Sweep done — asia-southeast1 shows 2 vendors with limited spare racks, asia-northeast1 (TKO) currently constrained for g5g, but loaner route looks feasible. Details in thread gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/apt-sweep (internal).

sam: Uploaded cost draft: https://drive.internal/redwood/apac-gpu-costs. Reserved + spot overlay looks like the best compromise.

ida: I'll start the PO draft and ping finance. Anyone want to review before I submit?

mira: @sam @lee quick review pls, else I'll submit tomorrow morning.

sam: Reviewing now, will comment in doc. :thumbsup:

eng-bot: Note: when reserving, set "eviction_policy": "fallback-route" in rollout config to ensure automatic regional failover.

mira: Thanks everyone. Will update after finance confirmation. :rocket:
